output.headline: Ironvale wanawabana Northgate Rovers kwa presha!
output.text: Ironvale Athletic wanaongoza 1-0 na hawawapi Northgate Rovers nafasi! Callum Reid na Hiro Tanaka wameiba mpira, kisha Tanaka akachukua mpira kwa tackle safi. Ni kama kuwazuia njiani kila wanapojaribu kupanga mashambulizi!
